verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (forewarn): CORRECTED from a plain 'highest base-power move' framing -- (1) Status moves are NEVER revealed, full stop (they rank as 0, below the minimum threshold of 1); (2) OHKO moves are ranked as if base power 150, and Counter/Metal Burst/Mirror Coat as if 120, regardless of their real (0/variable) listed power; (3) a variable-power move with no listed base power (that isn't a Status move) is ranked as 80; (4) ties are broken RANDOMLY among all qualifying moves, not by any fixed priority. Informational only, no battle effect.
